reading.title: PRINCE GEORGE'S COUNTY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORT Reference No.: CR-20-2024

candidates.quote: The Prince George's County Council convened as the Committee of the Whole on April 23, 2024, to consider CR-020-2024 (Proposed DR-2), which is a Resolution approving the terms and conditions of a Payments in Lieu of Taxes (“PILOT”) agreement between Prince George’s County and KCG SSP Capitol Heights LP, the owner.
candidates.wording: Payments in Lieu of Taxes (“PILOT”) agreement

candidates.quote: This project is a one hundred seventy-five (175) unit affordable rental housing community for families earning sixty percent (60%) or below the Area Median Income (“AMI”), located at Karen Boulevard and Wilberforce Court, Capitol Heights, Maryland, 20743.
candidates.wording: one hundred seventy-five (175) unit affordable rental housing community
